title: DGCA Remote Pilot Certificate - Small Class Rotorcraft
content: Price: ₹20,000 + GST. Duration: 5-7 days. Includes online/offline theory classes, simulator training, and practical flying sessions at the Indore site. Successful candidates receive a Remote Pilot Certificate (RPC) valid for 10 years.

title: DGCA Multirotor Drone Training
content: Price: ₹25,000 + GST. Duration: 5-7 days. Focuses on advanced multirotor operation, flight safety rules, and DGCA guidelines. Simulator practice and hands-on flight execution are key components.

title: Training Course Eligibility
content: Candidates must be between 18 and 65 years old, have passed the 10th standard or ITI equivalent, and hold a medical fitness certificate from a registered MBBS doctor.

title: Documents Required for Enrollment
content: Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, Driving License or Passport, 10th standard mark sheet/certificate, MBBS Medical Fitness Certificate, and 4 passport-size photos with a white background.

title: Other Advanced Drone Skill Courses
content: Duration: 3-5 days. We offer courses in Aerial Mapping & Surveying (RTK/PPK GNSS, Pix4D), GIS & Geospatial Analysis, Thermal & Multispectral Imaging (Solar inspections), AI/ML for Drones (computer vision), Assembly & Maintenance, and Drone Entrepreneurship.
